## Use Case

## MIT vs Pro Scope

Which tier should this land in? (mark the relevant one)
- [ ] MIT freemium (this repo) — local-first, no Pro dependencies
- [ ] Pro tier (would belong in the private ImpForge Pro repo)
- [ ] Both — distinct fresh-rewrite implementations per repo

If MIT: confirm the feature does NOT require Pro-only modules (e.g. the full 4-model orchestrator pipeline, the Pro mobile bridge, the Pro intent classifier, or the Pro knowledge fabric).

## Additional Context

Mockups, links, references to research, or related issues.
